name: Servo Test
instructions: Connect the servo signal wire to GPIO18, connect servo power, and connect servo ground to Raspberry Pi ground before running.

name: UART Loopback Test
instructions: Connect GPIO14 TXD, physical pin 8, to GPIO15 RXD, physical pin 10, before running. Make sure UART is enabled and serial console is disabled.

name: SPI Test
instructions: Enable SPI before running. Wire MOSI GPIO10 pin 19 to MISO GPIO9 pin 21, add a 10k pull-down resistor from MISO GPIO9 pin 21 to GND, wire SCLK GPIO11 pin 23 to GPIO5 pin 29, CE0 GPIO8 pin 24 to GPIO6 pin 31, and CE1 GPIO7 pin 26 to GPIO13 pin 33.

name: Wi-Fi Ping Test
instructions: Connect the Raspberry Pi to a Wi-Fi network before running. This test checks wlan0, accepts IPv4 or IPv6, and pings google.com through the Wi-Fi interface.

name: GPIO 26-Pin LED Test
instructions: Connect three 10-segment LED displays with current-limiting resistors. GPIO 2 through GPIO 11 go to Display 1, GPIO 12 through GPIO 21 go to Display 2, and GPIO 22 through GPIO 27 go to the first 6 segments of Display 3. GPIO2 and GPIO3 may stay on when idle because they are I2C pins with pull-ups.
observation_prompt: Did each LED segment light correctly, including the final all-LEDs-on check?

name: Audio Playback Test
instructions: Insure that the speaker is connected to the AUX port and is turned on. This test generates a 5-second tone in software and requires manual listening confirmation.
observation_prompt: Did you hear the 5-second audio tone clearly?
